verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents API coverage across most of its product surface: connected accounts and onboarding, card issuing and authorization controls, card expenses, bills/AP, single and batch transfers, FX conversion, and Global Accounts. That coverage is reinforced by SDKs, a CLI, and an AgentOS toolkit for agents acting on production accounts. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, so parity is implied by breadth rather than proven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence for UI-only areas (e.g., account settings, user/team management, reporting), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
